1) The above unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and were thereafter approved by the Board of Directors of the Company held on October 24, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out limited review of the unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended on September 30, 2026. Their limited review report does not have any qualification/modification.
2) The unaudited consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the applicable Indian Accounting Standards as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules 2015 and Amended Rules, 2016.
3) "Effective April 1, 2026, our Subsidiary Company has transitioned from previous Indian GAAP to Ind AS. Accordingly, the financial statements of the Subsidary Company have been aligned with the uniform accounting policies followed by the Group for consolidation purposes. Consequent to the subsidiary's transition to Ind AS on April 1, 2026, the Group has restated the comparative consolidated financial figures for the corresponding quarter ended March 31, 2026, and the previous financial year ended March 31, 2026. This restatement ensures comparability across all periods presented in these consolidated results.
The impact of the subsidiary’s transition to Ind AS on the Group's consolidated financial performance is summarized below:
Particulars Year Ended 31.03.2026 (Rs. in Lakh)
Consolidated Total Comprehensive Income as previously reported 4,892.84
Adjustments due to Subsidiary's Ind AS Transition:
(i) Remeasurement of defined benefit obligations (Gratuity under Ind AS 19) 97.44
(ii) Fair valuation and measurement of employee loans (3.29)
(iii) Fair valuation of financial liabilities (0.04)
(iv) Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning on financial assets 3.67
(v) Deferred tax impact on transition adjustments (5.79)
(vi) Provision for warranty obligations (39.06)
Consolidated Comprehensive Income under Ind AS (Restated) 4,945.77
Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) of subsidiary (Net of Tax) -
Total Comprehensive Income for the Group 4,945.77
4) The Company is in business of manufacturing of Plastic Extrusion plant and machinery and therefore the Company's business falls within a single business segment. Therefore "Segment Reporting" is not applicable to the Company as per the requirements of Indian Accounting Standard Ind AS 108.
5) The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on April 28, 2026, had recommended a Final Dividend of 15% i.e. Rs. 0.15 per equity share of face value of Rs.1 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, subject to approval of the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting (AGM). The shareholders of the Company approved the said Final Dividend at the AGM held on September 29, 2026. The dividend payout was completed on October 23, 2026.
6) The Corresponding figures of the previous year’s /periods’ have been regrouped/rearranged, whenever required.
